name: dedup_collapses_duplicates
description: Two observations sharing the dedup key (tars, d, 0, 0), same variant, different weights (0.5 vs 0.9). The key-collision fold keeps the variant at the MINIMUM weight (0.5) — order-independent, not first-write-wins (2026-07-20, GuitarAlchemist/hari#27). The expected output is unchanged from the pre-fix corpus only because the smaller weight happens to arrive first here; under min-fold the result no longer depends on that ordering, where first-write-wins would have kept 0.9 for the swapped input.
